Google is giving college students a full year of AI Pro for free. Here's what you get.

India students get Google AI Plus free for 12 months. Gemini Omni, 400 GB storage, double the usage limits. Worth ₹4,800 in India.

Redeem by December 31, 2026. Auto-renews at full price after the free year unless you cancel.

Sign up → one.google.com/ai-student
